newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's BCH could buy Endesa stake in Fenosa.
newsitem.headline: Spain's BCH could buy Endesa stake in Fenosa.

text.p: Spain's BCH could buy 7.5 percent of Endesa's stake in Union Fenosa's, BCH and Fenosa chairman Jose Maria Amusategui said on Monday.

"Endesa has to sell its stake in Union Fenosa under obligation of the electricity protocol, a stake the rest of the shareholders will take up," Amusategui said in a news conference to present 1996 results to shareholders.
Regarding the opposing positions of Union Fenosa and BCH in the privatisation of Retevision, Amusategui said:
"The electric companies received an offer from Stet which was impossible to reject and it did not seem fair to prevent Fenosa from participating in this option, he said.
Union Fenosa shares rose 35 pesetas on Monday to 1,340.
